description: Update builds installed in a project (pkg.lock.json) to their newest version within the installed major version, or the newest overall with latest=true. Verifies integrity like install_builds and replaces only files nobody edited since install; edited or deleted files are left untouched and reported as conflicts to merge by hand. Returns the new versions' integration notes.

builds.description: Build ids to update, e.g. ["tneemo/hono-auth"] (default: every installed build)

dry_run.description: Show what would change without writing anything

force.description: Also overwrite files edited since install

install_dependencies.description: Explicit opt-in after reviewing dry_run output and warnings; runs npm with ignore-scripts and pip with wheels only

latest.description: Allow new major versions, which may need code changes

name: update_builds
title: Update installed builds
